text: Given a tools/list call with valid credential Headers, When the server responds, Then it returns exactly the 11 eset_* tools, each description <= 500 characters

Given a POST /mcp request missing one or more of X-Eset-Username, X-Eset-Password, X-Eset-Region, When the server handles it, Then it returns 401 listing the missing Header name(s) and makes no outbound call
Given GET /health with no Headers and ESET Connect mocked unreachable, When called, Then it still returns 200 {"status":"ok"}
Given eset_list_devices called with no limit, When the mocked API returns more than 50 devices, Then the tool returns at most 50 items and has_more=true
Given eset_list_devices called with limit=9999, When handled, Then the effective limit sent upstream is clamped to 200, not rejected
Given eset_get_device with a deviceUuid the mocked API reports 404 for, When handled, Then the tool returns {"error":{"code":"not_found","retryable":false}}
Given eset_list_detections with a filter matching nothing in the mocked API, When handled, Then the tool returns {"items":[],"has_more":false}, not a not_found error
Given eset_resolve_detection on a detectionUuid the mocked API reports as already-resolved (409), When handled, Then the tool returns a structured outcome, never an unhandled exception
Given eset_assign_policy called with neither deviceUuid nor groupUuid, When handled, Then it is rejected client-side with {"error":{"code":"invalid_argument"}} before any outbound call
Given eset_unassign_policy with an assignmentUuid the mocked API reports 404 for, When handled, Then the tool returns {"error":{"code":"not_found","retryable":false}}

Given the mocked API returns 429 with Retry-After: 1 then succeeds, When a tool call is in flight, Then it retries once honoring Retry-After and returns the successful result; given it keeps returning 429, Then it returns {"error":{"code":"rate_limited","retryable":true}}

Given two concurrent async tool calls carrying different X-Eset-Username/X-Eset-Region Headers, When both are in flight on the same process, Then a stub tool reading the request ContextVar mid-call never observes the other request's credentials
Given a second tool call reuses the same X-Eset-Username/X-Eset-Region within the cache TTL, When handled, Then auth.py does not call the mocked token endpoint a second time
Given the cached JWT entry is forced to an expired state, When a tool call reuses the same credentials, Then auth.py calls the mocked token endpoint again
Given a fresh clone of the repo, When reading README.md, Then it documents the 3 required Headers and includes the MSPbots Connector section verbatim
steps: Open README.md on the work branch
Locate the Header table and the MSPbots Connector section
expect: README.md contains a 3-row table (X-Eset-Username, X-Eset-Password, X-Eset-Region) with required/meaning/where-to-obtain columns, and the MSPbots Connector section matches reference/readme-connector-section.md verbatim
